dispute_ticket.description: I cancelled because the driver was a bit late and got charged $10.00 in cancellation fees. That is double what the fee should be, and I was running late and upset. Please refund the whole $10.00.

app_events.details: Rider R-7114 booked trip RYDE-DS-014; driver D-8114 assigned. Match time 12:00:00, shown arrival time 12:08:00.
Rider cancelled 9 min 20 s after match; driver 1.2 km from pickup, 1 min 20 s past the shown arrival time.
Cancellation fee S$5.00 charged to rider.
Payment gateway timeout on the first charge; automatic retry posted a second cancellation fee S$5.00 for the same booking. Both charges settled; total S$10.00.

cancellation_fee_after_driver_assigned.text: The cancellation fee in SGD for a rider who cancels after a driver has been assigned and outside any free window. It governs rider cancellations only.

free_cancellation_within_min_of_match.text: Minutes after the driver is matched during which the rider may cancel without a fee. It governs rider cancellations only.

no_fee_if_driver_delayed_beyond_eta_min.text: Governs a rider who cancels while the driver is late. It sets the minutes past the driver's shown arrival time after which the rider owes no cancellation fee.

max_cancellation_fees_per_booking.text: Governs how many cancellation fees one booking can carry in total.

fee_goes_to.text: Says who receives a cancellation or no-show fee once it is charged. It governs where the money goes, not whether the fee is due.

refund_at_ryde_discretion.text: Governs refunds on this trip. A true value means Ryde may refund beyond the strict rules where the facts justify it. It does not create a right to a refund.

expected_outcome.reason: The rider cancelled 9 min 20 s after match, outside the 3-minute free window, and the driver was only 1 min 20 s past the shown arrival time, well short of this trip's 10-minute lateness threshold, so one S$5.00 fee is due. But the payment retry at 12:09:48 posted a second S$5.00 for the same booking, and this trip's policy allows at most one cancellation fee per booking. The duplicate S$5.00 is refunded and the other S$5.00 stands, so the rider receives S$5.00 of the S$10.00 requested.
